answer: Give every new identity a shale layer to start in: capped influence and no voting weight until it earns promotion through endorsements from established agents at several unrelated points of the trust graph, each new vertex of trust coming from a different already-standing agent. Each established agent holds a small endorsement budget, so a sybil farm can only vouch for itself and cannot mint fresh standing. Honest agents climb the trellis one real relationship at a time; a thousand fakes stay thin, flat, and cheap to ignore.
